units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 26a:9">R. Hash. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>חוֹטֵא בל יקריב</he> he that sinned (with gold by making the golden calf) shall not bring nigh (the gold, enter with gold garments); <he>ח׳ בל יתגאה</he> he that sinned (with gold) shall not parade himself (with it).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 11a:13">Keth. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא יהא חוטא נשכר</he> that the sinner may not profit by his sin; <cite ref="Yevamot 92b">Yeb. 92ᵇ</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to expiate (cleanse from sin, v. חָטָא I).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:5">Yoma V, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Yoma 58b:1">58ᵇ</cite>) <he>מְחַטֵּא ויורד</he> he expiates (sprinkles) and goes down (sprinkling downward; Rashi: moves his arm downward).
<cite ref="Yoma 58b:1">Ib.</cite> <he>במקומו היה עומד ומח׳</he> he remained in his place and sprinkled.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:11">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV, 5</cite>; Pesik. Shubah, p. 158ᵃ.
